official_sources.verified_fact: OS describes OSTN15 as the definitive OSGB36/ETRS89 transformation and states new vs archived National Grid coordinates agree on average better than 0.1m RMSE.
OS Terrain 50 grid data is verified to 4m RMSE; used here only as independent coarse reference, not parcel elevation.
OGC WCS Core defines mandatory coverage-service requirements; WCS 2.0 includes CRS and Range Subsetting extensions.
OGC WCS 2.0.1 executable tests require an advertised protocol in GetCapabilities and validate coverage/axis identifiers.

quality_effect: prevents CRS ambiguity, unsupported WCS request semantics and coarse Terrain50 values from being promoted as parcel-level measurements
